title: Birational quasi-modification
statement: A morphism of schemes is a birational quasi-modification when its source is integral, its target is reduced, it is separated, quasi-compact, and locally of finite type, the closure of the image of the source generic point is an irreducible component of the target, and the induced residue-field map at the source generic point is an isomorphism. The source-integral and target-reduced conditions use [def-pc-integral-scheme] and [def-pc-reduced-scheme], separated finite type uses [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and the component condition uses [def-weil-irreducible-components].
